gen-gf-offside-gf-maven-pro: Curves that refuse to close give Offside a wide, level, commanding stride. Maven Pro, a gentle sans with a high-waisted lowercase and one steady line thickness, gives that display swagger somewhere welcoming to land.
gen-gf-offside-gf-michroma: Offside draws its wide-tracked letters like bent pipe cleaner, expressive and commanding, with curves that never quite close. Michroma sets its sans-serif letters far apart, so paragraphs unroll slowly.
gen-gf-offside-gf-miriam-libre: Expressive and commanding, Offside runs wide and level on curves that stay open, with no swings in weight. Miriam Libre, a tall, wire-light sans with generous s bends, stays approachable throughout.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Curves that refuse to close give Offside a wide, level, commanding stride. And Mochiy Pop One fills in below with a sans of very large lowercase and one stroke width.

gen-gf-offside-gf-montserrat-underline: Curves that refuse to close and wide tracking give Offside its expressive, quietly level, commanding stance. Montserrat Underline brings a sans with open, uniform-walled bowls and oversized lowercase letters.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mozilla-headline: Tube-bent and wide-set, Offside commands attention with curves that refuse to close and no shifts in weight. Mozilla Headline, a plain sans with big lowercase, reads friendly paragraph after paragraph.

gen-gf-offside-gf-nata-sans: Offside sets wide-tracked letters in a level, expressive hand, its curves refusing to close and its weight never shifting. Nata Sans, a plain sans with open-mouthed curves, steadies the whole thing.
gen-gf-offside-gf-nobile: Bent-wire signage, wide and level: Offside keeps its curves open and its stroke uniform. Nobile, a plain sans with caps close to x-height and open letter mouths, matches that restraint below.
